reference_title: EM 1110-2-2104, Strength Design for Reinforced Concrete Hydraulic Structures (USACE, dated 1 November 2023, published 8 January 2025)
scope_note: Full-manual coverage. Chapters 1-5 body text extracted (chapter01.json through chapter05.json). Appendices B-D (design equations + investigation/design worked examples) are implemented as Python lookups (flexure_axial.py, design.py) rather than re-narrated chapter text -- their content is equations and numeric examples, not descriptive prose. Appendix E (11 structure-specific example load-combination tables) and Appendices F/G (commentary) are NOT extracted as chapter text; F/G's two data tables (target reliability, shear coefficient comparison) are digitized directly in loads.py/shear.py. The figure catalog covers all 32 figures across the whole document (Chapters 2-5, Appendices B/C/D/F).
